summary: Iteration 53 testing complete. All 4 feature groups verified: (1) Job OS bom_rollup_cost uses BOM raw material cost only (code verified at lines 4422-4431), (2) Item purchase_price field + PO auto-update working, (3) Inventory warehouse requirement + warehouse_stock updates + aggregated stock endpoint working, (4) Number Series CRUD + auto-code generation for Supplier/Customer/PO working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 features all verified: (1) Job OS bom_rollup_cost calculation at lines 4422-4431 uses only BOM component material costs (quantity * unit_cost), excluding process_cost_per_unit from completed WO operations. (2) Item purchase_price field added with auto-sync to unit_cost on creation if unit_cost not set; PO creation auto-updates both purchase_price and unit_cost. (3) Inventory transactions require warehouse_id for stock-changing types (receive/issue/adjust); warehouse_stock collection updated; GET /api/warehouses/stock/by-item returns aggregated stock by item. (4) Number Series at /api/settings/number-series supports CRUD for supplier_code, customer_code, po_number, sales_invoice; auto-generation uses get_next_series_number() helper.

job_os_bom_rollup_cost.details: Code at lines 4422-4431 calculates bom_rollup_cost as sum of BOM component (quantity * unit_cost) only, excluding process costs. Verified via code review and BOM explode endpoint test.

item_purchase_price.details: POST /api/items with purchase_price stores it correctly. If unit_cost=0, it auto-syncs to purchase_price. Frontend shows 'Purchase Price (₹)' field with data-testid='item-purchase-price-input'.

po_auto_update_item_price.details: POST /api/purchase-orders updates item.purchase_price and item.unit_cost to the PO line unit_price. Verified with test_po_creation_updates_item_price.

inventory_warehouse_requirement.details: POST /api/inventory/transactions without warehouse_id returns 400 'Warehouse is required for stock-changing transactions'. Frontend shows required Warehouse select with data-testid='transaction-warehouse-select'.

warehouse_stock_update.details: Transactions with warehouse_id update warehouse_stock collection. Verified quantity increases correctly.

aggregated_stock_by_item.details: GET /api/warehouses/stock/by-item returns dict keyed by item_id with list of {warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_code, quantity}. Frontend Inventory page shows Warehouse column with per-warehouse breakdown.

number_series_crud.details: GET /api/settings/number-series returns all 4 series (supplier_code, customer_code, po_number, sales_invoice) with prefix/padding/next_number. PUT updates correctly. Frontend Settings page has Number Series tab with data-testid='number-series-tab'.

auto_code_supplier.details: POST /api/suppliers with code='' auto-generates from supplier_code series. User-provided code is used as-is.

auto_code_customer.details: POST /api/customers with code='' auto-generates from customer_code series.

auto_number_po.details: POST /api/purchase-orders uses po_number series for po_number field.

regression_existing_flows.details: Items CRUD, Suppliers list, Customers list, POs list, Warehouses list, Inventory list all working after number_series integration.
